tasks.e2e:local: VITE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID= VITE_POD_APP_DIR=granergize-e2e deno task build && E2E_LOCAL=1 VITE_POD_APP_DIR=granergize-e2e npx playwright test --project=local
tasks.e2e:local:reuse: VITE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID= VITE_POD_APP_DIR=granergize-e2e deno task build && E2E_LOCAL=1 VITE_POD_APP_DIR=granergize-e2e E2E_RESET=wipe E2E_LOGIN_REUSE=1 npx playwright test --project=local
tasks.e2e:local:matrix: VITE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID= VITE_POD_APP_DIR=granergize-e2e deno task build && deno run -A test/e2e-local/matrix.ts
tasks.e2e:stress: VITE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID= VITE_POD_APP_DIR=granergize-e2e deno task build && E2E_LOCAL=1 LOGIN_STRESS=1 npx playwright test --project=stress
tasks.bench:ui: VITE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID= deno task build && LOCAL_POD_SERVER=jss E2E_LOCAL=1 E2E_BENCH=1 npx playwright test --project=bench && deno run -A --node-modules-dir=auto test/bench/plots.ts
tasks.bench:ui:css: VITE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID= deno task build && LOCAL_POD_SERVER=css E2E_LOCAL=1 E2E_BENCH=1 npx playwright test --project=bench && deno run -A --node-modules-dir=auto test/bench/plots.ts
tasks.handbuch: VITE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID= deno run -A npm:vite build --outDir dist-handbuch && E2E_LOCAL=1 LOCAL_PORT_OFFSET=40 E2E_RUN_ID=handbuch PREVIEW_OUTDIR=dist-handbuch npx playwright test --project=support && bash docs/build-handbuch.sh
tasks.videos: VITE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID= deno run -A npm:vite build --outDir dist-videos && E2E_LOCAL=1 LOCAL_PORT_OFFSET=60 E2E_RUN_ID=videos PREVIEW_OUTDIR=dist-videos npx playwright test --project=video && bash test/e2e/videos/postprocess.sh soll-ist && bash test/e2e/videos/postprocess.sh vertrieb vertrieb-a vertrieb-b && bash test/e2e/videos/postprocess.sh benchmark benchmark-a benchmark-c benchmark-payoff
